name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. `/git:commit`'s step 3 escape check now runs `commit-coverage.js` (via `spec-paths commit-coverage`) instead of the retired git-blame/jq heuristic, gated on a fix-typed commit subject, and offers on any touched file a reviewed spec landed — still never blocking the commit.
